children: IX Acquisition executed two additional Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFE Note Agreements No. 6 and No. 7) to fund its pending merger with AERKOMM. With these additions, the company now has $13.0 million of SAFEs that will automatically convert at the merger closing at $11.50 per share. Upon conversion, investors are expected to receive 1,130,435 shares of Parent common stock plus an additional 1,062,609 Incentive Shares to be held in escrow and released upon achieving specified milestones. The agreements are intended to bolster liquidity and align post-closing equity incentives.
